import asyncio
from typing import AsyncIterator, Awaitable, Callable, Optional

import websockets


ASSEMBLYAI_STREAMING_URL = "wss://api.assemblyai.com/v2/realtime/ws"


async def stream_chunks(
    audio_source: AsyncIterator[bytes],
    send_audio: Callable[[bytes], Awaitable[None]],
    *,
    close_after: Optional[bool] = True,
) -> None:
    async for chunk in audio_source:
        if not chunk:
            continue
        await send_audio(chunk)
    if close_after:
        await asyncio.sleep(0)


async def stream_chunks_via_assemblyai(
    audio_source: AsyncIterator[bytes],
    api_key: str,
) -> None:
    headers = {"Authorization": api_key}
    async with websockets.connect(ASSEMBLYAI_STREAMING_URL, extra_headers=headers) as ws:
        async def send_audio(chunk: bytes) -> None:
            await ws.send(chunk)

        await stream_chunks(audio_source, send_audio)

+    return None

+    if alt is None:

+import asyncio
+import os
+import queue
+import threading
+
+import pyaudio
+from google.cloud import speech
+
+
+class MicrophoneStream:
+    def __init__(self, rate: int = 16000, chunk: int = 1600):
+        self.rate = rate
+        self.chunk = chunk
+        self._buff = queue.Queue()
+        self._audio_interface = pyaudio.PyAudio()
+        self._audio_stream = None
+        self.closed = True
+
+    def __enter__(self):
+        self.closed = False
+        self._audio_stream = self._audio_interface.open(
+            format=pyaudio.paInt16,
+            channels=1,
+            rate=self.rate,
+            input=True,
+            frames_per_buffer=self.chunk,
+            stream_callback=self._fill_buffer,
+        )
+        return self
+
+    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb):
+        self.closed = True
+        if self._audio_stream is not None:
+            self._audio_stream.stop_stream()
+            self._audio_stream.close()
+        self._buff.put(None)
+        self._audio_interface.terminate()
+
+    def _fill_buffer(self, in_data, frame_count, time_info, status_flags):
+        self._buff.put(in_data)
+        return None, pyaudio.paContinue
+
+    def generator(self):
+        while not self.closed:
+            chunk = self._buff.get()
+            if chunk is None:
+                return
+            data = [chunk]
+            while True:
+                try:
+                    chunk = self._buff.get(block=False)
+                    if chunk is None:
+                        return
+                    data.append(chunk)
+                except queue.Empty:
+                    break
+            yield b"".join(data)
+
+
+async def stream_microphone(language_code: str = "en-US", interim_results: bool = True):
+    client = speech.SpeechClient()
+    config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
+        encoding=speech.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
+        sample_rate_hertz=16000,
+        language_code=language_code,
+        enable_automatic_punctuation=True,
+    )
+    streaming_config = speech.StreamingRecognitionConfig(

+

+

+
